snippet.title: Hexrite - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
✨HEXRITE IS RELEASING IN 2026!✨

You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

✨Collect, upgrade and cast dozens of spells!
🔮Conjure Domes, powerful magical fields of magic!
🧙Meet a cast of quirky characters in your journey!
🌌Explore floating towers and haunted cities!

WISHLIST TODAY! 🪄
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621770/Hexrite/

Music by Joe Sua
